title: Define electric current

hook.scenario: Nadi mein paani ka flow fast ya slow ho sakta hai.
hook.question: Waise hi wire mein electric charge ke flow ko hum kya kehte hain?

mental_model.intuition: Electric current wire ke andar electrons ki nadi (river) jaisa hai.
mental_model.description: Jaise paani ka flow water current hota hai, waise hi electric charges ka flow electric current hota hai. Jitne zyada charges ek second mein guzrenge, current utna hi zyada hoga.

explanation:
Electric current ka matlab hai rate of flow of electric charges. Kisi conductor, jaise copper wire, ke andar negative charges (electrons) ek direction mein bhagte hain.

Mathematical terms mein, electric current ko I se denote karte hain. Iska formula I = Q / t hota hai, jahan Q total charge hai aur t time hai.

Electric charge (Q) ki unit Coulomb (C) hoti hai aur time (t) ki unit second (s) hoti hai. Isliye, current ki SI unit Ampere (A) hai. Ek Ampere ka matlab hai ki 1 Coulomb ka charge kisi cross-section se 1 second mein flow kar raha hai.

Chhoti currents ko measure karne ke liye milliampere (mA) ya microampere (uA) ka use hota hai. Current ko measure karne wale device ko ammeter kehte hain, jise hamesha series mein connect kiya jata hai.

key_points.title: SI Unit
key_points.detail: The SI unit of current is Ampere (A).

worked_example.problem: A current of 0.5 A is drawn by a filament of an electric bulb for 10 minutes. Find the amount of electric charge that flows through the circuit.

steps.narration: Pehle time ko seconds mein convert karte hain.
Current aur time diya hai, charge Q nikalna hai.
Formula Q = I * t use karte hain.
Multiply karke charge find karte hain.

worked_example.problem: If 120 C of charge passes through a wire in 1 minute, calculate the electric current.

steps.narration: Time ko seconds mein badalte hain.
Current ka formula I = Q/t use karte hain.

common_mistakes.title: Not converting time to seconds
common_mistakes.explanation: I = Q/t formula mein time ko hamesha seconds mein rakho. Agar 1 minute diya hai, toh usko 60 seconds mein convert karna mat bhoolna.

recall_questions.q: What is the SI unit of electric charge?

recall_questions.answer: The rate of flow of electric charges.

oa_questions.question: What does an electric circuit mean?
oa_questions.answer: A continuous and closed path of an electric current is called an electric circuit.
oa_questions.approach: Define circuit as a closed loop for current to flow.
